VOOL LMC – load management controller for EV charging
Use the full capacity of your grid connection. VOOL LMC balances the load and switches phases automatically, so fuses stay safe.
Use your full grid capacity. Keep every fuse safe.
The LMC sits in your electrical cabinet, measures the building’s load in real time and gives the spare capacity to the chargers. No grid upgrade needed.
If one phase fills up, charging moves to a less loaded phase or slows down. The load stays balanced.
Nothing to configure day to day. The VOOL App shows electricity use and phase load in real time.
When it steps in, the car keeps charging, the lights stay on and the washing machine finishes its cycle.
